page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine driven by the Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. The instance allocates 20 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 10 physical cores with hyperthreading across the x86_64 architecture. Hardware features include 260 MB of L3 cache, alongside support for instruction sets like AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and int8). The system is equipped with 160.0 GB of memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, and includes 1182 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage. There are no discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses provisioned with this instance.

Benchmark results place the compute and throughput profile primarily within the middle tier. In raw compute tests, the E20ds_v6 produced a Geekbench single-core score of 1662.0 and a multi-core score of 11504.0, complemented by a PassMark CPU mark of 32372.66 and a stress-ng multi-core metric of 19963.97. Data handling benchmarks demonstrate consistent capacity, recording 150.84 GB/sec for uncached read memory bandwidth and 78.61 GB/sec for uncached write bandwidth. In-memory data store evaluations showed 28.38 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 35.9 GB/sec. CPU-driven inference exhibited top-tier text generation on small models (393.88 tokens/sec on 135M), while standard prompt processing and larger model execution remained in average brackets.

Cost efficiency for the E20ds_v6 centers on high memory density and integrated local high-speed NVMe storage. Because the instance pairs 160 GB of RAM directly with 1.18 TB of NVMe scratch space, workloads avoid excessive remote storage costs for transient data. The primary architectural tradeoff is the absence of dedicated hardware accelerators, which restricts high-parameter AI model generation, and the reliance on hyperthreaded cores instead of exclusive full physical cores for all 20 threads. This resource profile fits enterprise relational database systems, in-memory caches, data transformation jobs, and mid-sized analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by a 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8573C processor. The hardware profile offers 20 dedicated vCPUs across 10 physical cores, 160.0 GB of memory (8.0 GB per core), and a bundled 1182 GB NVMe SSD, operating without dedicated GPUs. In benchmarks, the instance delivers balanced throughput, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 32372.66, 150.84 GB/sec in uncached read memory bandwidth, and 28.38 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks. It exhibits top-tier performance in lightweight CPU-based language model text generation while sustaining consistent mid-tier execution for broader computational and compilation tests. Combining large memory arrays with fast local disk makes the instance resource-efficient for heavy memory-bound tasks without requiring external disk attachments. It is primarily suitable for in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, data processing, and enterprise application hosting.
